
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yellow3gold/p/20448811" title="发布于 2026-06-11 15:10">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MySQL 大批量 LONGTEXT 数据迁移导致临时表空间溢出的解决方案</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">事情是这样的，我有一个 MySQL 表，大概 100 个 G，但数据只有 10000 条。</p>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">看起来行数不多，奈何每条数据里塞了好几个 <span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">LONGTEXT</code> 字段，单条数据体量巨大。</span></p>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">最近需要对这张表做一个备份操作：根据批次 ID（<span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">batchid</code>）把某批数据备份到另一个库，然后删掉原表里对应的数据。</span></p>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]"><span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom">目标库有同名表，用来归档历史数据。思路很直接，两条 SQL 搞定：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 先把数据迁过去</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INSERT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INTO</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> history_db.target_table
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">*</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> target_table <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> batchid <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">381</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 再把原表数据删掉</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DELETE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> target_table <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> batchid <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">381</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">结果一执行直接报错，要么是：</p>
<blockquote class="relative rounded-[.0625rem] border-l-2 border-[var(--intensity-10)] pl-2 text-[var(--intensity-50)]">
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">SQL 错误 [3] [HY000]: Error writing file 'C:\Windows\TEMP\MLa4gsg6dpk9s2z8ry' (OS errno 28 - No space left on device)</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">要么是：</p>
<blockquote class="relative rounded-[.0625rem] border-l-2 border-[var(--intensity-10)] pl-2 text-[var(--intensity-50)]">
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">SQL 错误 [1114] [HY000]: The table 'C:\Windows\TEMP#sql6f88_bd086f_2' is full</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">MySQL 是装在Windows服务器的，不过明明装在 D 盘，为什么 C 盘会爆？</p>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">实际上，MySQL 在执行大事务或者大查询时，会在系统临时目录（<span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">C:\Windows\TEMP</code>）生成临时文件。当一次操作的数据量太大，临时文件直接把 C 盘写满了，SQL 自然就挂了。<span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">INSERT ... SELECT</code> 一次性搬运大量 <span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">LONGTEXT</code> 数据，临时表膨胀得飞快（现象就是服务器剩余50G的C盘迅速飙红，待执行失败后又恢复正常）。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">既然一步到位不行，那就化整为零——用存储过程分批处理：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> DEFINER<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span>`root`@`<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">%</span>` <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PROCEDURE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> `business_db`.`batch_migrate_and_delete`(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">IN</span> p_table_name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">VARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">128</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">IN</span> p_batchid      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BIGINT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)
batch_migrate_and_delete: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BEGIN</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DECLARE</span> v_min_id    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BIGINT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DECLARE</span> v_max_id    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BIGINT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DECLARE</span> v_batch_size <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DEFAULT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">500</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 获取 id 范围</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@sql_range</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CONCAT(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">SELECT MIN(id), MAX(id) INTO @v_min, @v_max FROM </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        p_table_name, </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> WHERE batchid = </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, p_batchid
    );
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PREPARE</span> stmt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@sql_range</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXECUTE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stmt;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DEALLOCATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PREPARE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stmt;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> v_min_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@v_min</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> v_max_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@v_max</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">IF</span> v_min_id <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">IS</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">THEN</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        LEAVE batch_migrate_and_delete;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">END</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">IF</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 每批先迁移到历史库，再删除原表数据</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHILE</span> v_min_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> v_max_id DO
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@sql_insert</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CONCAT(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">INSERT INTO history_db.</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, p_table_name,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> SELECT * FROM </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, p_table_name,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> WHERE batchid = </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, p_batchid,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> AND id BETWEEN </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, v_min_id, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> AND </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, v_min_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">+</span> v_batch_size <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">-</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        );
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PREPARE</span> stmt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@sql_insert</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXECUTE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stmt;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DEALLOCATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PREPARE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stmt;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@sql_delete</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CONCAT(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">DELETE FROM </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, p_table_name,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> WHERE batchid = </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, p_batchid,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> AND id BETWEEN </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, v_min_id, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> AND </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, v_min_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">+</span> v_batch_size <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">-</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        );
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PREPARE</span> stmt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@sql_delete</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXECUTE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stmt;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DEALLOCATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PREPARE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> stmt;

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">COMMIT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SET</span> v_min_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> v_min_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">+</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> v_batch_size;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">END</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHILE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">END</span> batch_migrate_and_delete</pre>
</div>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">创建存储过程后，执行call即可</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>CALL batch_migrate_and_delete(<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">target_table</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">381</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>存储过程的核心思路很简单：先用 <span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">MIN(id)</code> 和 <span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">MAX(id)</code> 圈出要处理的数据范围，然后每次取 500 条（<span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">v_batch_size</code>），做完 insert 和 delete 立刻 <span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">COMMIT</code>，再继续下一批。这样每批事务体量都很小，临时文件来不及撑爆 C 盘就已经释放了。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">⚠️ 需要注意的是：</p>
<ul class="my-2 pl-5 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]">
<li class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]"><strong>​<span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">v_batch_size</code> 要结合实际调</span></strong>。我这里的表单条数据就很大，设 500 差不多。如果你的表行数多但单条很小，可以适当调大；反过来单条更大就调小一些，核心是控制每批事务的数据总量。</li>
<li class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]"><strong>按 <span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">id BETWEEN</code> 分批的前提是 id 连续或大致连续</span></strong>。如果 id 有大量空洞，可以换成 <span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">LIMIT</code> 配合游标的方式分批。</span></li>
<li class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]"><strong>迁移和删除放在同一个事务批次里</strong>。先 insert 成功再 delete，万一 insert 失败，当前批次不会被删掉，数据不会丢。</li>
<li class="my-2 p-0 text-[length:var(--chat-text-size)] leading-[var(--chat-line-height)]"><strong>Windows 下装 MySQL 要留意临时目录位置</strong>。如果 C 盘实在太小，可以在 MySQL 配置文件里把 <span class="inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto align-bottom"><code class="inline-block whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border-[var(--intensity-6)] bg-[var(--intensity-4)] px-1.5 font-mono text-[length:var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-font-size)] leading-[var(--chat-markdown-inline-code-line-height)] text-[var(--text-primary)]">tmpdir</code> 指向其他盘，从根源上避免这个问题。</span></li>
</ul>

</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
